verdict.rationale: Community benchmarks note Solid is among the 'fastest and smallest JS library' options (solid-comm-8) and GitHub docs emphasize near-vanilla-JS performance (solid-gh-17) and built-in state management reducing need for third-party libs (solid-gh-2), which indirectly supports a small, dependency-light footprint. However, there is no first-party documentation of actual bundle size figures, tree-shaking guarantees, or explicit supply-chain risk reduction claims. Missing for 10: official bundle-size benchmarks/comparisons, explicit dependency-count/audit data, and direct supply-chain-risk messaging.
